context.title: La Mesa-Spring Valley Teachers Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: La Mesa-Spring Valley School District — Measure AA (La Mesa-Spring Valley School District Classroom Repair & Upgrade Extension Measure)

positions.statement: Kathy Sheets (President, La Mesa-Spring Valley Teachers Association) signed the argument in favor of La Mesa-Spring Valley School District Measure AA in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
